scope: Read-only independent recomputation of all retained baseline-repeat LHR reports and all nine mobile resource records. No browser, service, build, test or production-source operation.

source.sourceVerificationScope: Checks recorded source-manifest hashes and each retained LHR artifact hash, not an independent rebuild or rehash of every source file.

conditions.lighthouseThrottling: default mobile simulate, identical explicit flags to the formal collector
conditions.contentValidity: Current formal same-navigation content gatherer/audit; expected URL, locale, visible content and absence of loading/error. Failed raw reports are retained, never replaced.
conditions.resourceWindow: networkidle plus document.fonts.ready, before scrolling or eager forcing
conditions.execution: Serial diagnostics; operator must ensure no concurrent task build or sampling. Existing user desktop applications remain untouched.
conditions.authentication: Fresh dedicated browser without supplied cookies or authorization; public TEST routes only

measurementDefinitions.javascript: Separate 390x844 cold-context, disabled-cache initial resource navigation. Each actual decoded script body recompressed with Node gzip; summed unique URL bodies. Not Lighthouse transferSize and not whole-build bundle size.
measurementDefinitions.font: Per actual Lighthouse measured navigation, every network-requests item with resourceType Font is retained. transferSize is the recorded transfer byte count; resourceSize is reported resource bytes. No font measurements exist in the separate script/image resource pass.
measurementDefinitions.lcp: Lighthouse default mobile simulated LCP; not observed raw local timing or real-user CWV. Each group has all three values and the median, min and max.
measurementDefinitions.sampling: All 27 LHR files verified against stored SHA256; all nine resource records retained. No best-only selection, dropping failures, replacing runs, averaging medians or converting SHOULD into release approval.

resource.measurement: Actual initial navigation responses through network idle and fonts ready, before scrolling or forcing eager; decompressed JS response bodies recompressed with Node gzip for comparable budget, independent from actual wire encoding

eligibility: Require the complete formal report, all 63 retained raw reports, three runs per seven-locale/three-kind group, runtime/content validity for every run, and each source/build identity recorded by root.

Verify Lighthouse version 13.4.1, Chrome version, default mobile simulation/viewport/CPU/network settings, content gatherer category and absence of concurrent builds. Report differences instead of silently treating changed conditions as equivalent.
For direct JS comparison select only the formal resource row with the same locale, kind, path and 390x844 viewport. Keep 1440x900 and additional page kinds as formal-only evidence.
Extract font requests and bytes from each formal LHR using the same complete network-requests filter and category rules. Do not compare these against script/image-only resource rows.

Recompute all formal group medians/min/max from every retained raw report; compare each shared group median and absolute/percentage deltas. Also retain all three individual font totals because request count can vary by navigation timing.
Mark invalid/missing samples and groups invalid; preserve raw values and failures and do not create a new valid three-run group by excluding or retry-replacing them.
Whole seven-language acceptance uses all 21 formal groups and unchanged gates. The nine shared groups describe before/after changes only and cannot replace that gate.
comparisonPlan.deltaFormula: delta = candidate - baseline; percentage = 100 * delta / baseline when baseline is nonzero. A negative LCP/byte/request delta denotes reduction; performance score uses percentage-point difference.
comparisonPlan.retention: This review writes one new artifact only. Baseline budget FAIL, earlier diagnostic attempts, cold-font failures, warm overall FAIL and any later formal invalid/FAIL records remain intact.
comparisonPlan.causalityLimit: Byte/request reductions are directly measured. LCP changes reflect the complete candidate and local lab variability; this comparison alone cannot attribute each millisecond to the cart split or font partition.
